subject: Auto Parts Merchandising
examFormat: Two papers, both compulsory, taken at one sitting. Paper 1: forty multiple-choice questions in 50 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2: Sections A and B together last 2 hours for 100 marks. Section A (technical): three questions including a compulsory one, answer two including the compulsory one, for 40 marks. Section B (merchandising): four questions, answer three, for 60 marks.

topics.name: Safety in Auto Parts Merchandising Shop
objectives: Define safety
Identify safety clothing (helmet, goggles, hand gloves, nose mask, foot boots, overall dress)
Identify the types of fire extinguishers
State the causes and prevention of accidents

topics.name: Engine Parts
objectives: Identify engine parts, e.g. piston, piston rings, connecting rod, camshaft, crankshaft, valves, cylinder head and oil pump
Sketch the engine parts listed
State the location and functions of engine parts

topics.name: Transmission System (Clutch)
objectives: Identify the parts of a clutch (flywheel, clutch plate, pressure plate assembly and release bearing)
State the functions of the clutch parts

topics.name: Transmission System (Gear Box)
objectives: Identify the types of gear box: manual (3, 4 and 5 speeds) and automatic transmission
State the functions of the gear box

topics.name: Transmission System (Propeller Shaft and Rear Axle Assembly)
objectives: Identify the types of propeller shafts and universal/sliding joints
State the functions of the transmission system parts
Identify the parts of the axle assembly

topics.name: Suspension System
objectives: Identify the types: normal beam and independent suspension systems
Identify the parts of the suspension system: damper, springs (coil springs, torsion bar, leaf spring)
State the functions of the parts

topics.name: Cooling System
objectives: Identify the types: water and air cooling systems
State the functions of the cooling system
Identify the parts of water and air cooling systems: radiators, fan blade, fan belt, water pump, water hose and thermostat

topics.name: Steering System
objectives: Identify the types: manual and power assisted steering
Identify the parts of a steering system: steering gearboxes, steering wheel, steering shaft and tie-rod
State the functions of the parts

topics.name: Braking System
objectives: Identify the types: disc and drum
Identify the parts: master cylinder, wheel cylinder, connecting pipe, brake pads, brake shoes/lining
State the functions of the parts

topics.name: Lubrication System
objectives: Identify the parts: oil tank/sump, oil filter, oil cooler, oil seal, pressure switch and oil pump and types
Distinguish the types of lubricant (oil and grease)
Identify the types of oil (SAE40, SAE60 and SAE 30/20w)
State the quality and uses of oil and grease

topics.name: Electrical Parts
objectives: Identify the components: battery, fuse, electrical control unit/brain box, alternator, ignition coil, bulb and cut-out
State the functions of the components

topics.name: Wheels and Tyres
objectives: Identify the types of wheel: spoke wheel, alloyed wheel and pressed steel wheel
Distinguish tube and tubeless tyres
State the sizes of wheel and tyre
State the functions of wheel and tyre

topics.name: Types of Tools and Their Uses
objectives: Identify general tools (spanner, hammer, mallet, allen key, screw driver and plier)
Identify special tools (extractor, pullers, sledge hammer and lifters)
Differentiate general tools from special tools

topics.name: Care of Tools
objectives: State ways of caring for tools, e.g. greasing, cleaning and packing
State the effects of improper tool care

topics.name: Test Equipment
objectives: Identify the types of test equipment: spark plug cleaner, engine analyzer, dwell angle tester, exhaust gas analyzer and vacuum tester
State the functions of the different types of test equipment

topics.name: Maintenance of Test Equipment
objectives: Start and stop the equipment correctly
State the importance and uses of manufacturers' manuals

topics.name: Accessories
objectives: Define accessories
State the importance of accessories
State how to care for accessories
Identify the types: steering cover, car radio, wheel cover, seat cover and car cover

topics.name: Storage
objectives: Define storage
Describe the process and ways of storing parts
State the reasons for proper storing of parts

topics.name: Cataloguing
objectives: Define cataloguing
State the functions of a catalogue
Describe the process of locating auto parts using a catalogue

topics.name: Re-Order Quantity
objectives: State the meaning and importance/advantage of re-order quantity
Describe the process of re-ordering auto-parts quantity/stock
State the principle of maintaining parts/stock level and its importance
Calculate re-order level, FIFO and LIFO

topics.name: Visual Presentation
objectives: Describe methods of item presentation/grouping/arrangement of parts (by branding and manufacturers/models)
State the advantages of item presentation

topics.name: Inventory
objectives: Define inventory
Identify the types: daily, periodic and annual
Describe the procedure for inventory taking (use of bin card)

topics.name: Product Sourcing
objectives: Define product sourcing
State the ways of sourcing products
State the importance of product sourcing

topics.name: Sales
objectives: Define sales
Identify the types: cash and credit/deferred sales
Describe the methods of selling: personal, door-to-door, trade fairs, open market, unit shops
Explain the procedure for sales calls

topics.name: Invoicing
objectives: State the meaning, contents and uses/importance of an invoice

topics.name: Forecasting
objectives: Define forecasting
State the need/reasons for and advantages of forecasting

topics.name: Record Keeping
objectives: Identify the types of records: sales journal, purchases journal, sales ledger, purchase ledger, invoice, receipt and cash book
Describe the process of keeping the records
State the uses of the various records

topics.name: Fund Raising (Source of Finance)
objectives: Define fund raising
Identify the types of fund
Describe the sources/ways of raising fund
Describe the process/procedure of raising fund

topics.name: Market Analysis
objectives: Define market, market analysis and market segment
Explain market segmentation
Describe the procedure and basis for market segmentation

topics.name: Value Pricing
objectives: Define value pricing
Identify the types of value pricing
Apply value pricing

topics.name: Advertising
objectives: Define advertising
Identify the types and media of advertising
State the advantages of advertising

topics.name: Customer Service
objectives: State the meaning, types and importance/advantages of customer service
Handle customers' complaints

topics.name: Warranty/Guaranty
objectives: State the meaning and importance of warranty/guaranty
Describe the procedure for claiming warranty/guaranty rights
Describe the process of losing warranty rights

topics.name: Regulatory Bodies
objectives: State the reasons for regulation
Define quality control and its types
State ways to improve quality
Identify examples of regulatory bodies (Standards Organisation of Nigeria - SON, Consumer Protection Board and Society of Automobile Engineers - SAE)
State their functions

topics.name: Introduction to Auto Parts Merchandising
objectives: Define merchandising
Explain auto parts merchandising

topics.name: Personal Qualities of a Merchandiser
objectives: State the qualities of an auto parts seller

topics.name: Ethical Business Behaviour
objectives: Define ethical business behaviour and identify its types
Explain the behaviour expected of an auto parts seller
